camel_example:
aliyun sas GetServerlessAppAuthDetail --region cn-hangzhou --AppId '3de9f2ac-f***769226df
' --VendorType SAE --MachineType RunD --AppRegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Retrieves the authorization details of a serverless application
kebab_example:
aliyun sas get-serverless-app-auth-detail --vendor-type SAE --machine-type RunD --app-id '3de9f2ac-f***769226df
' --app-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetServerlessAppAuthDetail

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service to which the application belongs. Valid values:
ASK
SAE
ACS
parameters.help_zh:
所属云产品：
ASK
SAE
ACS
parameters.name: vendor_type

parameters.help_en:
The server type. Valid values:
RunD
ECI
parameters.name: machine_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Serverless App Engine (SAE) application. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListMachineApps](~~ListMachineApps~~) operation. This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns an HTTP 400 error with the error code missingParams
parameters.help_zh: SAE 应用 ID，可通过 [ListMachineApps](~~ListMachineApps~~) 获取。本参数必填；未提供时，API 返回 HTTP 400，错误码为 missingParams
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the application. This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the API returns an HTTP 400 error with the error code missingParams
parameters.help_zh:
应用地域ID。

本参数实际为必填项；未提供时 API 返回 missingParams（HTTP 400）
parameters.name: app_region_id

IsBind.description_en:
Indicates whether the authorization is bound. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
IsBind.description_zh:
是否已绑定授权。取值：

true：是
false：否

IsPostPaid.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance uses the pay-as-you-go billing method. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
IsPostPaid.description_zh:
是否后支付实例。取值：

true：是
false：否

IsServerlessPostPaidValid.description_en:
The pay-as-you-go status of the serverless application. Valid values:
true: Active.
false: Expired
IsServerlessPostPaidValid.description_zh:
serverless后付费状态。取值：
true：生效中
false：已失效

PostPaidModuleSwitch.description_en: The switch configuration for pay-as-you-go modules. This field returns a JSON-encoded string. Each property name represents a module, and the property value 0 indicates that the module is disabled, whereas 1 indicates that the module is enabled
PostPaidModuleSwitch.description_zh: 按量付费模块开关配置。该字段返回 JSON 编码的字符串，各属性名称表示模块，属性值 0 表示关闭、1 表示开启

PostPaidOpenTime.description_en: The time when the pay-as-you-go billing method was activated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
PostPaidOpenTime.description_zh: 后付费开启时间。采用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

PostPaidStatus.description_en:
The pay-as-you-go instance status. Valid values:
1: Active.
2: Stopped due to overdue payment
PostPaidStatus.description_zh:
后付费实例状态。取值：
1：生效中
2：欠费停机

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：
true：成功
false：失败
